scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,admin,schol-api,schol -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run admin" "npm run school-intel:api" "npm run schol"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n server,client,admin,schol-api,schol -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run admin" "npm run school-intel:api" "npm run schol"
scripts.dev:all:billing: concurrently -n server,client,admin,billing,schol-api,schol -c blue,green,magenta,red,cyan,yellow "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run admin" "npm run billing" "npm run school-intel:api" "npm run schol"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install-server && npm run install-billing && npm run school-intel:install
scripts.test: concurrently "cd server && npm test" "cd client && npm test"
scripts.lint: npm run check:shared && npm run check:names && concurrently "cd server && npm run lint" "cd client && npm run lint"
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules admin/node_modules schol/node_modules capabble-landing/node_modules billing-service/node_modules client/dist server/dist admin/dist schol/dist .turbo
scripts.school-intel:install: cd school-intelligence && sh -c 'if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; fi; .venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]"'
scripts.dev:schol: concurrently -n schol-api,schol -c cyan,yellow "npm run school-intel:api" "npm run schol"
scripts.dev:core: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client"
